title: Predictive learning: computer vision
reading: The slide transfers the predictive-learning idea to vision through masked image modeling, i.e. the Masked Autoencoder, where a Transformer predicts the content of masked image patches. A before/after figure of a flamingo photo illustrates the setup, and the slide credits 'Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners, CVPR 2022'.

visuals.description: Left: a flamingo photo split into a 5x5 patch grid with most patches greyed out; an arrow points right to the full unmasked patch grid showing the complete flamingo image.
visuals.assertion: Given a heavily masked patch grid as input, the model reconstructs the full image, so the training signal comes from predicting hidden patches.

concepts.name: Masked image modeling / Masked Autoencoder (MAE)
concepts.why_it_matters: Self-supervised pretraining for vision by reconstructing masked patches.

concepts.name: Transformer
concepts.why_it_matters: Backbone architecture that operates over image patch tokens.

verbatim_spans: Predict the masked patches using Transformers
